slides.texte_overlay:
How to be the friend
every man wishes he had

1. Pick up at 2 a.m.

No questions first.
Just "where are you?"

2. Remember what matters
to him

The interview, the surgery,
his kid's game. Ask about it.

3. Say the hard thing
in private

Honest, kind, one time.

4. Show up for the move

Early. With gloves.

5. Hype his wins

In the group chat. Out loud.

6. Bring something new
to the table

A book, a fact, an idea.
Good friends make you sharper.
